# Instructions for Copilot

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the one set of
rules for every agent that works on this repository.

Add no agent or tool attribution to anything you write here: no
`Co-authored-by` trailer for an AI agent, no "Generated with" or "Generated by"
line, and no session link, in commit messages, pull request text, comments,
code or documents.

## When you review a pull request

Check these first, and say which file and line each finding is about:

- New `unsafe` code, or a manual `Send` or `Sync` implementation, outside
  `crates/frost-collections-core/src/adaptive/seq/buf.rs`.
- A Cargo feature that changes an existing type's representation, hasher,
  bounds or freeze/thaw partner, or a package that does not forward a feature
  of a package below it.
- A new test or benchmark with no catalog or inventory record, or a changed
  catalog ID.
- A verification claim that the change does not support: a check reported as
  passed that was not run, or research mathematics presented as test evidence.
- A document that names a path that no longer exists.
- Agent or tool attribution in a commit message, comment or document.
